title: About ReCircle
body_html:
Circular commerce, beautifully done

ReCircle is a refurbishment workshop and marketplace. We take pre-loved electronics, fashion and furniture, restore them to near-new condition, and give them a second life — with a proper warranty and a transparent condition grade.

Our standards

  • Every device data-wiped to DoD 5220.22-M standard
  • Every item graded A–D by an independent technician
  • 12-month minimum warranty
  • 14-day EU-wide returns

Why refurbished?

Building a new phone emits ~80 kg of CO₂e before it even reaches a shelf. Refurbishing one emits less than 5 kg. Every ReCircle purchase is a small vote for slower, smarter consumption.

title: Sustainability report
body_html:
Sustainability report

We publish our impact numbers every quarter. No greenwashing — just the maths.

2024 at a glance

  • 482 tonnes of CO₂e avoided
  • 18,000+ products saved from landfill
  • 96% of incoming devices successfully refurbished
  • 4% recycled for parts

Methodology

CO₂ figures follow ADEME lifecycle assessments for each product category. We take the lower bound of published estimates and subtract our refurbishment energy use, parts, and shipping.

Supply chain

Primary sources: trade-ins (62%), corporate refresh programmes (24%), certified recyclers (14%). No products sourced from landfill-diversion brokers.

Third-party verification

Our annual report is audited by Clérance Solutions (B Corp certification pending 2025).

title: Trade in your old device
body_html:
Trade in your device for instant credit

Get a same-day quote, free shipping label, and store credit within 48 hours of receipt. Data wipe certified.

How it works

  1. Use the calculator below to get an instant quote.
  2. Print the free UPS label we email you.
  3. Drop your device at any UPS point.
  4. We inspect, confirm grade, and credit your account within 48h.

The calculator on this page uses a transparent formula: base_price × condition_multiplier × age_factor. No hidden deductions.

title: FAQ
body_html:
Frequently asked

Is “refurbished” the same as “used”?

No. Used means “as-is.” Refurbished means an independent technician has tested, repaired, cleaned and certified the product. Every ReCircle item comes with a warranty.

What warranty do you offer?

Electronics: 12 months. Appliances: 24 months. Fashion: 30-day authenticity guarantee. Furniture: 12–24 months structural.

Can I return if I change my mind?

Yes — 14-day EU returns on all items. No questions asked.

How do I trade in my device?

Use our trade-in calculator. Instant quote, free shipping label, credit in 48h.

Do you ship outside the EU?

We ship to UK, Switzerland and Norway. Shipping times 3–7 business days.

How is CO₂ calculated?

See our Sustainability report for the full methodology.
